items.title: Russia and North Korea open first road bridge across Tumen River
items.title_zh: 俄朝首座跨境公路桥通车：图们江上的后勤加速器
items.summary_zh: 9月7日，俄罗斯与朝鲜开通跨图们江首座专用公路桥（雅科夫·诺维琴科桥），连接俄哈桑与朝豆满江，全长约1公里、双向两车道，设计日通约300车次与2300人。两国总理视频剪彩；工程约90亿卢布，2025年4月动工。外界视其为乌战以来俄朝补给与贸易通道升级，可能加剧制裁规避与军事物流关切。

quotes.author: Mikhail Mishustin / 俄总理
quotes.en: I am convinced that the expansion of transport infrastructure near the border will give a powerful boost to the further development of trade, economic, technological, scientific and cultural cooperation.
quotes.zh: 我确信，边境运输基础设施的扩展将有力推动贸易、经济、科技与人文合作的进一步发展。

items.fetch_notes: NM首页curl易429；WebFetch抓到significance列表估分6.2；据Guardian/TASS/DW公开报道

items.title: Keep Our Servers Running
items.title_zh: 保住我们的服务器：互联网档案馆九月经常性捐赠三倍匹配
items.summary_zh: 互联网档案馆发起九月经常性捐赠三倍匹配筹款，HN 约 940 赞。志愿者强调 Open Library 缺人手；长期月捐者也吐槽要与爬虫抢带宽、取消捐款流程笨拙。公共记忆基础设施的资金与治理再次上首页。

quotes.author: raybb
quotes.en: I have been volunteering with the Internet Archive via Open Library for about half a decade now. Sending money is awesome and they're also always looking for volunteers! There are so many projects going on for Open Library and staff has quite a few volunteers but right now especially I think it would be awesome to have a few more experienced folks joining to help (many volunteers are students). Here's just a few things we could use more experienced folks to help on: - Solr performance, it curren
quotes.zh: 我为互联网档案馆的 Open Library 志愿工作了大约五年。捐钱很棒，他们也一直在找志愿者！Open Library 有很多项目在推进。

quotes.author: zetanor
quotes.en: I like the theory of the IA enough that I have a reoccurring donation, but I've thought a few times about e-mailing them to cancel (they have to halt your monthly donation charges manually). There's plenty of things I can overlook, like having to compete with scrapers to get a single page to load, or a myriad of longstanding technical issues (my favorite being that the collection upload system silently and irrevocably leaks your e-mail address: https://archive.org/post/240444/help-to-hide-email
quotes.zh: 我认同 IA 的理念，也在定期捐款，但好几次想过发邮件取消（月捐要他们手动停）。有些事我能忍，比如要和爬虫抢带宽……

items.title: Novo Nordisk STEP Young: semaglutide helps ~40% of children 6–12 exit obesity class in 68 weeks
items.title_zh: 诺和诺德STEP Young：司美格鲁肽助约四成6–12岁儿童68周后脱离肥胖
items.summary_zh: 诺和诺德公布STEP Young III期初步结果：165名6至未满12岁肥胖儿童随机接受每周一次司美格鲁肽或安慰剂，并同做饮食与运动干预。68周时司美组约40.4%不再被归为肥胖，安慰剂组为0%；基线超85%属II/III级重度肥胖。完整数据拟于ObesityWeek 2026发布，儿童长期安全性与标签外使用争议同步升温。

quotes.author: Novo Nordisk
quotes.en: 40.4% of the children treated with semaglutide were no longer classified as having obesity after 68 weeks compared with none (0%) treated with placebo.
quotes.zh: 接受司美格鲁肽治疗的儿童中，有40.4%在68周后不再被归类为肥胖，而安慰剂组为0%。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分6.2；据公司通稿/LifeScienceNordic/Ynet公开报道

items.title: An Alien Mind
items.title_zh: 一颗外星心智：OpenAI 谈更强模型与防御军备逻辑
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 博客《An Alien Mind》讨论更强模型的风险与继续训练的理由，HN 约 461 赞、451 评。评论区迅速把“防御其他 AI”读成军备竞赛叙事，也有人用外星博物馆展签戏仿其修辞。

quotes.author: sho_hn
quotes.en: One of my favorite things to do with these blog posts is to imagine an Alien Museum on the Remains of Humanity, and wonder what the little text flyouts and commentary on the screenshot of this one might say. Some ideas: "Despite a nuanced view of the complexities of what lay ahead, humanity found itself collectively unable to stop the process it had set in motion." "Despite significant progress on the mechanisms of alignment, failure lay in humanity's inability to agree on who or what AI should
quotes.zh: 我最喜欢拿这类博客帖想象一座‘人类遗迹外星博物馆’，想想截图旁的小说明会怎么写。

quotes.author: pu_pe
quotes.en: > The strongest argument I see for continuing to train much smarter models quickly is the need to build defensive systems against the dangers posed by other AI. So the best argument for AI is that it's an arms race. We have to keep pushing every boundary because in any case others will, and we will need to defend against them. If this statement is true, then this particular researchers believes the open source Chinese models are not simply distilling, and will continue to improve. Every ML resea
quotes.zh: 我看到继续快速训练更强模型的最强理由，是需要建立对抗其他 AI 危险的防御系统。所以 AI 最好的论据竟是军备竞赛。

items.title: UN rights chief Volker Türk: advanced AI could become existential risk to humanity
items.title_zh: 联合国人权高专蒂尔克：先进AI或成对人类的“生存性风险”
items.summary_zh: 人权高专Volker Türk在人权理事会第63届全球更新中警告，若缺乏约束规则、独立核验与红线，先进AI可能失控并构成对人类的生存性风险；他称“少数男人几乎拥有对AI的无限权力”，将致信头部公司要求立刻降风险，并呼吁宿主国与供应链就禁用用途达成国际红线。

quotes.author: Volker Türk
quotes.en: I am calling here, today, for an all-out effort to put cast iron guarantees in place around the safety and security of AI, before it is too late.
quotes.zh: 我今天在此呼吁全力以赴，在为时已晚之前为AI的安全与安保装上铸铁般的保障。

items.title: De-Brainrot Vacations
items.title_zh: 去脑腐假期：把脑力劳动从可选项里抢回来
items.summary_zh: 一篇度假“去脑腐”随笔冲上 HN 约 461 赞。作者与读者共振于“脑子不一样了”：成瘾媒体与工作 AI 让心智努力变成可选项；老一辈工程师则对比没有持续多巴胺的年代。

quotes.author: FinnLobsien
quotes.en: I think the „my brain isn’t the same anymore“ sensation is pretty universal. Between addictive online media in our personal lives and AI at work, I think we’ve made mental effort largely optional. That must be a horrible thing. One of my favorite theories is the physical activity transition. In my grandparents‘ generation, physical movement became more optional as work shifted from manual labor to knowledge work or operating machines and transportation became motorized. Exercise was an ambient b
quotes.zh: ‘我的脑子不再一样了’这种感觉相当普遍。个人生活里成瘾的网络媒体，工作里又有 AI，我们把脑力劳动几乎变成可选项了。

quotes.author: woodgala
quotes.en: As someone who started their software engineering career in 1988 and is at the tail end of it, I can report that my peers and I have experienced the same thing, even as we start retiring. What we didn’t have was constant dopamine hits. It took effort to get dopamine. A lot. I’ve struggle with doomscrolling in my 50’s, just like teenagers, except I remember a time when it didn’t exist. I think that’s the key: if all you’ve ever had is velveeta, you’re going to have to work twice as hard to unlock
quotes.zh: 我 1988 年入行软件工程，如今快退休了，可以作证同辈也经历过同样的事。我们那时没有持续的多巴胺冲击——多巴胺得费很大劲才来。

items.title: Saudi Arabia preparing near-Additional Protocol IAEA powers under US 123 deal, Grossi says
items.title_zh: 格罗西：沙特在美沙123协议下筹备接近附加议定书的IAEA核查权
items.summary_zh: IAEA总干事拉斐尔·格罗西表示，美沙民用核“123协议”并未要求利雅得签署附加议定书，但双边安排正写入对浓缩/转化等敏感活动“非常接近附加议定书”的核查授权；细节敲定后将提交理事会。防扩散组织批评协议缺少附加议定书与“金标准”禁浓缩条款。

quotes.author: Rafael Grossi / IAEA
quotes.en: For those we are going to have authorisations and capacities which are very, very similar to those that you may find in an Additional Protocol.
quotes.zh: 对于这些（敏感）活动，我们将拥有与附加议定书中非常非常接近的授权与能力。

items.title: 216M Spy TVs – The LG Smart TV Problem [video]
items.title_zh: 2.16 亿台间谍电视：LG 智能电视问题（视频）
items.summary_zh: 视频拆解 LG 智能电视监听与合同条款，HN 约 456 赞、703 评。评论引用家电 T&C：用户须告知在场所有人可能被窃听；有人五年前关掉联网被嘲，如今感觉被证实。

quotes.author: Animats
quotes.en: Here are LG's contract terms for appliances.[1] They are awful. Not only can they listen in. You have a contractual requirement to tell everyone in range of an appliance that they may be eavesdropped upon. CONSENT REQUIREMENT: You acknowledge and agree that it is your sole responsibility to obtain all necessary consents from any third parties whose voices may be captured by the Product and to notify household members and guests that their voices may be captured and processed, in compliance with
quotes.zh: 这是 LG 家电合同条款，糟糕透顶。它们不但能窃听，你还有合同义务告知范围内所有人可能被窃听。

quotes.author: korzinka
quotes.en: I've bought an LG Smart TV 5 years ago, read t&c where I was supposed to grant them any data they wanted, decided to disagree and kept all network functions disabled. I was ridiculed by my friends for that. At some point, I thought - maybe I'm really crazy to do so? Who am I, a caveman, a luddite? Oh well, I'm not. Not a bad tv though, many HDMI ports!
quotes.zh: 五年前买了台 LG 智能电视，读完条款要我交出一切数据，于是拒绝并关掉所有联网功能。朋友们都嘲笑我。

items.title: South Korea weighs Hormuz deployment under US pressure as Iran war risks rise
items.title_zh: 美施压下韩国权衡霍尔木兹部署：巡逻机与补给舰方案浮出
items.summary_zh: 在美伊冲突与霍尔木兹通航危机背景下，白宫催促严重依赖中东石油的韩国拿出资源承诺。首尔检讨派遣P-8巡逻机、海军补给舰与排爆小组等“非作战搜救/监视”方案，须国会批准；执政党内亦有顾虑，作战升级令计划反复校准。

quotes.author: Chung Bin-na / 韩国国防部
quotes.en: We are closely consulting with the international community, including the US, on ways to make a substantive contribution toward the swift restoration of freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.
quotes.zh: 我们正与包括美国在内的国际社会密切协商，探讨如何为迅速恢复霍尔木兹海峡航行自由作出实质性贡献。

items.fetch_notes: NM列表估分5.9；据Korea Herald/JoongAng/SBS公开报道

items.title: bzip3
items.title_zh: bzip3：新一代 Burrows-Wheeler 压缩再上首页
items.summary_zh: bzip3 开源压缩工具再次登上 HN（约 365 赞）。作者曾解释 BWT 用法并补进大型文本基准；实务派则比较 lzma/gzip 在 jsonl 归档与 DuckDB 生态中的取舍。

quotes.author: altairprime
quotes.en: Previously: “Hi, tool author here.” A useful explanation of Burrows-Wheelers transform as used by bzip3: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42902407 “bzip3 is not yet listed on the large text compression benchmark” It is now: https://mattmahoney.net/dc/text.html (2 years ago, 176 comments) https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=42899713 (4 years ago, 104 comments) https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31324439
quotes.zh: 此前作者本人解释过 bzip3 用的 Burrows-Wheeler 变换。当时说还没进大型文本压缩基准；现在已经进去了。

quotes.author: 8organicbits
quotes.en: I was processing compressed .jsonl files recently (JSON lines format). I found that lzma gave a much better compression than gzip or bzip2, which helps for archival costs, but it's challenging to work with as software support is lacking. I do duckdb processing which supports gzip transparently. There's an extension for bzip2, but not for lzma or bzip3. I ended up using gzip because it's best supported by the software I use and most likely to have support in software I adopt. But it gave the wors
quotes.zh: 我最近在处理压缩的 .jsonl。发现 lzma 比 gzip/bzip2 压得好很多，利于归档成本，但软件支持不足，用起来费劲。
